findings.description: Keyboard focus on the product list controls (sort select, product links, Add to cart buttons) computes to outline-style none, so no visible focus indicator is drawn on Tab navigation. Confidence is moderate: the focus screenshot did not clearly show a ring on the focused element.
repro: Open http://127.0.0.1:33037/ and sign in as customer-ad52.
On /inventory.html at 1280 px, press Tab repeatedly.
Inspect the focused element: outline-style is none, with no box-shadow.

notes: Checked login, catalogue, product detail, cart, checkout overview totals (39.98 + 3.20 tax = 43.18, correct), 360 px layouts (no horizontal overflow on inventory, cart, detail, checkout step one), console errors (none), and basic DOM a11y (img alt, button names, html lang). Not tested: checkout completion, cart quantity changes, sort order, hamburger menu, screen reader behaviour, colour contrast, and tablet widths.
